argv:
import hashlib, json, re
S = open("tools/mutate-and-run.sh", encoding="utf-8").read()
E = ".ufo/evidence/round-18/sources-check/"
spec = open(E + "sources-check.defects.spec", encoding="utf-8").read()
suite = open(E + "suite.txt", encoding="utf-8").read()
pred = json.load(open(E + "predictions.json", encoding="utf-8"))
sweep = open(E + "sweep/sweep.txt", encoding="utf-8").read()
c7 = open(".ufo/evidence/round-16/round-gate/suite.txt", encoding="utf-8").read()
sha = lambda s: hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest()
m = re.search(r"cat >\"\$d/js-sources-check\.spec\" <<'EOT'\n(.*?)\nEOT\n", S, re.S)
emb = (m.group(1) + "\n") if m else None
print("EMBEDDED_SPEC_FOUND", bool(m), "line", S[:m.start()].count("\n") + 1 if m else None)
print("EMBEDDED_SPEC_EQ_PREREGISTERED", emb == spec, "emb_sha", emb and sha(emb), "prereg_sha", sha(spec))
legs = {}
for mm in re.finditer(r"regression_case_git (\S+) \\\n\s+'([^']+)' \"\$(PIN_\w+)\" \"\$(REV_\w+)\" \\\n\s+\"\$specs/(\S+)\" '([^']*)' \"\$(TABLE_\w+)\"", S):
    legs[mm.group(1)] = dict(path=mm.group(2), pin=mm.group(3), rev=mm.group(4), spec=mm.group(5), suite=mm.group(6), table=mm.group(7))
print("LEGS", len(legs), " ".join(legs))
L, R7 = legs["js-sources-check"], legs["js-round-gate"]
print("LEG8", L["path"], L["pin"], L["rev"], L["spec"], L["table"])
print("LEG8_SUITE_EQ_SUITE_TXT", L["suite"] == suite.rstrip("\n"), "suite_txt_trailing_newline", suite.endswith("\n"))
print("LEG8_SUITE_EQ_LEG7_SUITE", L["suite"] == R7["suite"])
print("CASE7_SUITE_TXT_EQ_CASE8_SUITE_TXT", c7 == suite, "case7_sha", sha(c7))
print("CASE7_SUITE_TXT", repr(c7))
print("CASE7_HAS_ENV_I", "env -i" in c7, "CASE8_HAS_ENV_I", "env -i" in suite)
v = dict(re.findall(r"^(PIN_SOURCESCHECK|REV_SOURCESCHECK|TABLE_SOURCESCHECK)=(\S+)$", S, re.M))
print("PIN_SOURCESCHECK", v["PIN_SOURCESCHECK"]); print("REV_SOURCESCHECK", v["REV_SOURCESCHECK"])
table = dict(p.split(":") for p in v["TABLE_SOURCESCHECK"].strip("'").split(","))
print("TABLE_KILLED", sum(x == "KILLED" for x in table.values()), "/", len(table), "SURVIVED", ",".join(k for k, x in table.items() if x == "SURVIVED"))
P = {k: d["prediction"] for k, d in pred["predictions"].items()}
meas = dict(re.findall(r"^DEFECT (\S+): (KILLED|SURVIVED|INCONCLUSIVE)", sweep, re.M))
print("PREDICTIONS_HELD_VS_SWEEP", sum(P[k] == meas.get(k) for k in P), "/", len(P))
print("TABLE_EQ_SWEEP", table == meas, "TABLE_EQ_PREDICTIONS", table == P)
print("PRED_SPEC_SHA_EQ", pred["spec_sha256"] == sha(spec), "PRED_SUITE_SHA_EQ", pred["suite_sha256"] == sha(suite), "PRED_SUITE_EQ_SUITE_TXT", pred["suite"] == suite.rstrip("\n"))
for k in ("MUTATE_DATE", "SWEEP_CONTEXT_COMMIT", "SWEEP_SPEC_SHA256", "SWEEP_TARGET_RECHECK", "PREDICTION_MATCH", "MEASURED_KILL_RATE"):
    print(k, re.search(r"^" + k + r": (.*)$", sweep, re.M).group(1))
print(re.search(r"^MUTATE: .*$", sweep, re.M).group(0))
print(re.search(r"^CONTROL: .*$", sweep, re.M).group(0))
